senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced.) height, excellence; pride, haughtiness.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 10b:27">Ber. 10ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 130:1">Ps. CXXX, 1</cite>) <he>אין ג׳ לפני וכ׳</he> there must be no hight (elevated stand during prayer) before the Lord.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 8:7">Esth. R. to IV, 15</cite> <he>מִגַּ׳ לב</he> from haughtiness.—Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 27 <he>גַּבְהוּתוֹ של עולם</he> the hight of the world, i.e. the Most High.
